_help: Featured jobs shown on jobs.html. Add one object per job. category must be one of: informatics, product, ux, implementation, success, ai, sales, data, operations. work_setting: Remote, Hybrid or On-site. posted: YYYY-MM-DD. When a role stops accepting applicants, add closed: true and closed_date: YYYY-MM-DD — it moves to the greyed-out list.

_example.description: One or two sentences about the role.

jobs.title: Clinical Specialist
jobs.description: Support healthcare professionals during medical procedures, give clinical training on medical devices, and help with product demonstrations and implementation. Looking for nurses with strong communication skills and an interest in medical technology; cardiology or medical device experience is an advantage. Full-time, entry-level.

jobs.title: Clinical AI Specialist
jobs.description: Use clinical knowledge to support AI development: working with medical data and images, reviewing AI outputs, and collaborating with clinical and technical teams. Looking for a health or medical background, experience with medical data or imaging, strong anatomy knowledge and attention to detail. Full-time.

jobs.title: Clinical Education Specialist
jobs.description: Train customers on medical devices, provide clinical support and help with clinical research. Looking for a registered nurse (or relevant clinical/science background) with strong communication and training skills. Fluent Hebrew and English and a valid driver's license required. Full-time.

jobs.title: Clinical Project Manager
jobs.description: Manage clinical projects, coordinate clinical samples and data, and work with hospitals, research partners and internal teams. Looking for a degree in Nursing or a related field plus 1–3 years in clinical research, operations or project management. Full-time; fluent English required.

jobs.title: Clinical Support – Orthopedics (Joints)
jobs.description: Clinical and technical support during orthopedic procedures, working directly with surgeons and OR teams, plus product education and training. Looking for a clinical or scientific background and an interest in medical devices.

jobs.title: Clinical Data Labeler
jobs.description: Review and classify clinical data used to train AI models, working closely with the AI team. A great entry point for nurses who want to apply clinical knowledge in AI.

jobs.title: Robotic Startup Specialist
jobs.description: Combine your OR background with training, implementation and supporting hospitals as they adopt new surgical technology. Requires a nursing degree and 2+ years of OR/surgical experience.

jobs.title: Patient Coordinator (Medical Navigator)
jobs.description: A full-time junior role at a health tech startup for Israeli-licensed RNs: working with clients, owning processes end to end, and collaborating with medical teams.
